legend.jmaTime.uncoveredBefore: Not covered: this time is before the start of stored data ({from}); this is not "none"
legend.jmaTime.uncoveredFuture: Not covered: the timeline is in the future
legend.jmaTime.uncoveredNoRows: Not covered: no data at this time (off season or collection gap); not zero
legend.jmaTime.historyHourly: In the past, hourly observations are shown (up to 60 min behind)
legend.jmaTime.volcanoSnapshot: Volcanoes are a current snapshot only: moving the timeline back still shows the present.
legend.jmaTime.quakesIncomplete: The 7-day window at this time starts before collection began, so some earthquakes may be missing.
legend.jmaTime.quakesHistory: In the past, shows earthquakes from the 7 days before that time, using the latest report issued by then.
legend.jmaTime.warningsHistory: In the past, shows warnings and advisories in effect at that time (10-minute steps).
legend.jmaTime.lightningCovered: This time is within the stored period (no dots = no lightning then)
legend.jmaTime.lightningNote: LIDEN has no current intensity, so dot size does not show strength; the database keeps 7 days; days are loaded by Taipei date (01:00 in Japan).
legend.jmaTime.wbgtNote: Four bands from the Ministry of the Environment daily-life guideline (25/28/31); colors are Pulse's own. Coordinates borrowed from AMeDAS stations; the service runs about Apr 22–Oct 21, off season is not covered.
legend.jmaTime.wbgtAttribution: Source: Ministry of the Environment heat illness prevention site (not under the Public Data License; credit required when reused)
legend.jmaTime.seasonalLabelNote: Labels: observed date and difference from normal (+ = later than normal); brackets show the normal date.
legend.jmaTime.notYetLate: Not yet observed and past the normal date (thick outline)
legend.jmaTime.snowcapNote: Up to the 2026 cold season this was judged by eye; from 2027 it is judged from analyzed snow depth, so the two are not directly comparable. Aug–Dec belong to the following cold-season year.
legend.jmaTime.phenologyNote: Drag the timeline to watch the front move (by date in Japan); records from 2021.
legend.jmaTime.rainyNote: Whole prefectures are colored (Amami split out by municipality); Hokkaido has no rainy season and stays blank; only 2026 so far.
